say:1:1131026001:1.text: They left to search for treasure! Some humans in black came with news about some very precious treasure hidden deep in the highlands.
say:1:1131026001:1.source_cn: 去找宝藏了！他们听那些穿着黑衣服的人类说，高原深处藏着...
say:1:1131026001:1.male: They left to search for treasure! Some humans in black came with news about some very precious treasure hidden deep in the highlands.
say:1:1131026001:1.female: They left to search for treasure! Some humans in black came with news about some very precious treasure hidden deep in the highlands.

say:2:1131026002:1.text: They are members of A... A damned Syndicate? Something like that...
say:2:1131026002:1.source_cn: 那些人类好像是叫什么黑……黑心商会？
say:2:1131026002:1.male: They are members of A... A damned Syndicate? Something like that...
say:2:1131026002:1.female: They are members of A... A damned Syndicate? Something like that...

say:4:1131026003:1.text: That's it! Many grown-ups of our tribe left with them to look for treasure.
say:4:1131026003:1.source_cn: 就是他们！部族里好多大人都跟着他们一起去找宝藏了。
say:4:1131026003:1.male: That's it! Many grown-ups of our tribe left with them to look for treasure.
say:4:1131026003:1.female: That's it! Many grown-ups of our tribe left with them to look for treasure.

say:5:1131026004:1.text: I don't know how much my parents will find, but they promised me the most delicious grilled cactus from Alkali!
say:5:1131026004:1.source_cn: 不知道爸爸妈妈能找到多少，他们还答应我，要给我买咸水镇...
say:5:1131026004:1.male: I don't know how much my parents will find, but they promised me the most delicious grilled cactus from Alkali!
say:5:1131026004:1.female: I don't know how much my parents will find, but they promised me the most delicious grilled cactus from Alkali!

say:6:1131026005:1.text: When will they be back? I can't wait!
say:6:1131026005:1.source_cn: 不知道他们什么时候才能回来，好期待呀！
say:6:1131026005:1.male: When will they be back? I can't wait!
say:6:1131026005:1.female: When will they be back? I can't wait!
